subject: NovumCare CAIQ: annotated evidence ledger + ingestion checklist
messages:
From: Elena Guerrero <elena@novumcare.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@novumcare.com
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 13:18:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ intake & ingestion — evidence ledger request

Hi Vivek / Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. As part of NovumCare's vendor review we need an ingestable mapping of Redwood's CAIQ answers plus material evidence we can attach to each control. Our audit team prefers a single "evidence ledger" spreadsheet with a short control statement, Redwood's answer, the artifact filename, artifact owner (email), and an ingestion flag (OK to upload to our secure portal).

Could you confirm whether you can provide: 1) an annotated ledger in the format below, 2) a short list of runtime log samples for CCM-05 / CCM-15, and 3) any KMS rotation proof for production keys?

Target timeline: we'd like the initial bundle by EOD Tue 13 Apr (we have an audit window the week after). If that's tight, let us know the earliest you can drop the first tranche.

Appreciate it — happy to hop on a 20-min call if that helps sort owners.

Best,
Elena Guerrero
Head of Vendor Security
NovumCare

--

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: Elena Guerrero <elena@novumcare.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 08 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake & ingestion — evidence ledger request

Elena — thanks for the clear ask. We can deliver an annotated ledger and sample artifacts per your format. High-level plan below:

1) Deliverable A (by Mon 12 Apr EOD): annotated evidence ledger (XLSX) with columns: Control ID, Control short statement, Redwood answer (Y/N/Partial), Artifact filename, Artifact owner (internal email), Evidence type (doc/log/screenshot), Ingestable (Yes/No), Notes.

2) Deliverable B (by Tue 13 Apr AM): runtime log snippet for CCM-05 & CCM-15 (redacted), plus a small script demonstrating the format (sample-runtime-log-snippet.txt).

3) Deliverable C (by Tue 13 Apr EOD): KMS rotation proof (redwood-kms-rotation-proof.pdf) and a one-page attestation for production key handling.

Owners: Marissa will own the ledger generation and artifact collection; Ben will run the runtime log extraction and perform redaction; Kimberly will validate controls mapping and residency flags. I'll coordinate ingestion permissions and sign-off.

Can you confirm the secure intake method? We can either: A) drop artifacts to a pre-provisioned SFTP you control, B) upload directly to your portal (please send upload credentials), or C) we share a Drive folder and you pull (less preferred for sensitive logs).

If those dates work we will begin the pull today and target the milestones above.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference

--

Elena / team — attaching the first tranche. Notes below and a couple of small asks:

Attachment: novumcare-evidence-ledger-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet) — contains 42 control rows to start, focused on in-scope CCM domains (Data Security, Key Management, Logging/Telemetry). I populated the Artifact filename column with the exact filenames we plan to upload: redwood-kms-rotation-proof.pdf, sample-runtime-log-snippet.txt, onboarding-tenant-separation.pdf, api-auth-flow-diagram.png.

Quick clarifications we need from NovumCare before we upload:
- Ingest method: please confirm the SFTP account name if you want us to push (option A) or provide the portal upload link (option B).
- Residency flags: a few controls reference EU data residency. For any row where you set "Ingestable=No", please include the reason so we can provide an alternate artifact or redaction.

Ben — FYI I redacted timestamps that could tie back to customer request ids; the runtime snippet is in the attachment.

Elena, I've also uploaded a working copy to our shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1XzNovumcareCAIQ (Drive link, access pending — let me know if you need explicit viewer access).

If useful we can do a short 15-min intake tomorrow at 10:30am ET to confirm owner mappings.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Marissa / Vivek — received, thank you. The spreadsheet looks good at a glance. We will accept an SFTP drop for sensitive logs. Please push to sftp-novumcare@uploads.novumcare.com (I asked our infra team to expect files from redwood-inference.com).

A couple of small asks before you push:
- For rows where "Ingestable" is No please add an alternate artifact or a redaction note.
- For KMS rotation proof, include the key alias and rotation timestamps in the PDF (redacted where needed) — our auditors need the alias + last rotated timestamp.

We can ingest the first tranche tomorrow morning. If you can push tonight, I'll confirm with our intake team and John Barker (our external auditor) will spot-check a few controls.

We'll take the Drive link as a backup; SFTP is preferred for the runtime logs.

Thanks again — looking forward to closing this window quickly.

Best,
Elena
Head of Vendor Security, NovumCare
